verdict.rationale: Docs mention 'creating a shared source of truth that includes context from your docs and repositories' to keep teams consistent (github-copilot-docs-9), which gestures at instructions/knowledge-context features, but the evidence pack never explicitly describes a project instructions file (e.g., copilot-instructions.md) or how coding standards/conventions are set and enforced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an instructions file mechanism, its scope/format, and confirmation the agent follows it during edits/completions.
